evidence_slice: OPDC adopted its Local Plan on 22 June 2022. The adopted policies map includes Site Allocations and the June 2022 modifications state that new site allocations 35 to 42 were included. Official OPDC Local Plan evidence identifies site allocation 35 as 4 Portal Way with a Local Plan homes capacity of 702. OPDC's Q2 2025-26 performance report records 669 homes at 4 Portal Way with Resolution to Grant status, subject to GLA Stage II and completion of the section 106 agreement. OPDC's public planning consultation identifies application 24/0051/FUMOPDC for mixed-use redevelopment at 4 Portal Way including 669 residential units. The GLA-hosted OPDC public policies FeatureServer layer 25 is the Site Allocations polygon layer, supports GeoJSON, and uses British National Grid EPSG:27700.

field_evidence.planning_status: Resolution to Grant in OPDC Q2 2025-26 performance report

binding_method: adopted OPDC site-allocation identifier plus current housing-delivery/planning record and GLA-hosted polygon FeatureServer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
